documents.title: Fictional Salesforce access requests
documents.text: Fictional Northstar policy, not Salesforce guidance. Salesforce access requests require a ticket in the internal service portal and approval from the requester's manager. Standard access requests are reviewed within 2 business days.

documents.title: Fictional Salesforce data export
documents.text: Fictional Northstar policy, not Salesforce guidance. Salesforce bulk export approval requires the data owner's written sign-off and a security review. The fictional escalation code is NORTHSTAR-EXPORT-42. Only administrators may read this procedure.

documents.title: Fictional Salesforce sandbox policy
documents.text: Fictional Northstar policy, not Salesforce guidance. Salesforce sandbox testing must use synthetic customer records. Production customer records must not be copied into the training sandbox.

documents.title: Archived fictional Salesforce access policy
documents.text: Archived fictional policy, not Salesforce guidance. Salesforce access requests are approved automatically without a ticket. This document was replaced by the current access policy.

documents.title: Fictional Salesforce incident routing
documents.text: Fictional Northstar policy, not Salesforce guidance. Report a Salesforce service outage to the internal incident desk. Include the affected workflow and start time, but exclude passwords and customer records.

documents.title: Fictional Salesforce onboarding
documents.text: Fictional Northstar policy, not Salesforce guidance. Salesforce onboarding requires the internal data-handling course before requesting production access. Training completion is recorded in the learning portal.
